issues.title: Export: add --output path option
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Let `tasklet export --output tasks.csv` write to a file instead of stdout.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `--output <path>` writes the CSV to the path.
- An unwritable path exits with status 2.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/export.py`
- `tasklet/cli.py`
- `tests/test_export.py`

issues.title: Export: optional UTF-8 BOM for spreadsheet apps
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Add `--bom` so spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 in files written with `--output`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `tasklet export --output tasks.csv --bom` starts the file with a UTF-8 BOM.

## Dependencies

Blocked by #50.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/export.py`
- `tests/test_export.py`

issues.title: Align columns in list output
issues.author: maintainer-a
issues.body:
## Summary

Pad task titles in `tasklet list` so the columns line up.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Titles in `tasklet list` are padded to the longest title.

## Touched Areas

- `tasklet/terminal.py`
